# Dissemination API endpoints
{: .no_toc}

Dissemination records the research output linked to projects: publications and the journals they appear in.

## Resources

| Resource | What it is | Portals |
|:---------|:-----------|:--------|
| [`publication`](/api/dissemination/publication/) | An article or preprint, linked to the projects it reports on. | private, public |
| [`journal`](/api/dissemination/journal/) | The shared list of journals publications appear in. | private, public |

## Supporting endpoints

Approval requests, membership invitations and link tables. Most workflows never call these directly; the main resources create and resolve them.

| Resource | What it is | Portals |
|:---------|:-----------|:--------|
| [`journalapproval`](/api/dissemination/journalapproval/) | A request to add or change a shared journal, reviewed before it takes effect. | private |
| [`publicationapproval`](/api/dissemination/publicationapproval/) | A request to add or change a shared publication, reviewed before it takes effect. | private |

All endpoints follow `https://www.brainstem.org/api/{portal}/dissemination/{resource}/` and support the common [query parameters](/api/#query-parameters).
